اغتنموا (form VIII)
# اِغْتَنَمُوا (iḡtanamū) /iɣ.ta.na.muː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِغْتَنَمَ (iḡtanama)
# اُغْتُنِمُوا (uḡtunimū) /uɣ.tu.ni.muː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِغْتَنَمَ (iḡtanama)
# اِغْتَنِمُوا (iḡtanimū) /iɣ.ta.ni.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِغْتَنَمَ (iḡtanama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
